ledger.summary: Clement's company will leave at noon. Richard must stay with Blaise because Whitwall expects war with Earl Walter the Black, a fair, false young tyrant now recovering from a wound. Richard has told Blaise that Ralph goes only as far as Cheaping Knowe, just beyond the mountains, and will be back in about half a month. Ralph tells Richard his whole story. Richard guesses the Lady had fay blood, foresaw her love would fade, and meant Ralph to find the damsel, whom Richard thinks loves him. Richard now believes the Well is real and that Ralph will find it. He has a good horse and gear ready; the company meets in Petergate by the church.
ledger.geography_notes: Cheaping Knowe lies close to the far side of the mountains seen from Whitwall, about half a month's round trip. Petergate is a street by the church.
open_questions: Is Earl Walter the Black the same Walter the Black wounded by the Knight of the Sun? (very likely; "hurt in a fray")
